_help: Real-time combat's settings; the mod menu's Real-time combat page shows them. enabled: real-time combat in Sandbox mode (false: the game's own fights there too). lock_on_reach_m: how far an animal can be to lock on to it (3 to 60 metres). cat_damage, enemy_health, enemy_damage: multiples of your cat's damage, the animals' health and their damage (1 is as made). animals_fight_back: whether they do; engage_range_m: how near an animal joins a fight by itself (0: only one your cat hits). keys: the keys for each action, by Unreal's names (Tab, MiddleMouseButton, MouseScrollUp, F, LeftAlt, Gamepad_RightThumbstick...): one, or a list; [] for none. They're read as the game starts: restart it after changing them.
